evals.name: basic-plan-review
evals.prompt: Tôi mới lập plan cho tính năng quản lý inventory trong game. Self-test hộ tôi plan này với basic mode.
evals.expected_output: Self-test report with basic mode analysis of the inventory plan
assertions: Report has 'Level: Basic' header indicating correct mode selection
Contains 3+ test examples covering normal, special, and edge cases
Has Correctness Check section with examples
Has Performance section
Has Extensibility & Maintainability section
Has Risk Assessment with impact, recommendation, and improvement outcome
Has Improvement Suggestions with priority ranking
Does NOT contain a full code implementation of the reviewed feature

evals.name: advanced-complex-plan-review
evals.prompt: Mình có plan cho hệ thống đồng bộ dữ liệu giữa client và server cho game online. Dùng advanced mode để self-test plan này.
evals.expected_output: Self-test report with advanced mode analysis of the sync system plan
assertions: Report has 'Level: Advanced' header indicating correct mode selection
Contains 5+ test examples covering normal, special, and edge cases
Has Security analysis section
Has Performance section with complexity table
Has Extensibility section discussing coupling and abstractions
Has Maintainability section covering error handling, logging, testability
Has Risk Assessment table with risk, impact, recommendation, and improvement outcome
Mentions clock drift or timestamp synchronization as a risk
Mentions retry storm or reconnect storm as a risk
Has Improvement Suggestions with priority ordering
Does NOT contain a full code implementation

evals.name: advanced-code-review
evals.prompt: Tôi vừa implement xong đoạn code QuestRewardHandler. Self-test advanced mode giúp tôi.
evals.expected_output: Self-test report with advanced mode analysis of the QuestRewardHandler code
assertions: Report has 'Level: Advanced' header indicating correct mode selection
Contains 5+ test examples covering normal, special, and edge cases
Identifies the 'remove before save' ordering bug as a critical issue
Identifies race condition / lack of thread safety as a risk
Has Performance section with complexity analysis
Has Security section
Has Extensibility & Maintainability sections
Has Risk Assessment with impact, recommendation, and improvement outcome
Has Improvement Suggestions with priority ordering
Does NOT contain a full fixed code implementation of the reviewed code
